text: Each member holds a signed mandate for their own agent: a limit, an expiry, and rules. It's our own AP2-style design, with a server-attested signature.
Three days out, the forecast flags Ravi: late twice, and his last payday was three weeks before the due date. He gets a nudge in Hindi.
Round three runs on its own. Five charges complete, confirmed through the PayPal Agent Toolkit. Ravi's charge is declined, labelled sandbox-injected.
The agent proposes only what the charter allows: the buffer covers Ravi now, he repays by PayPal invoice, and swaps turns with Tomas.
Now the members' agents answer inside their mandates. Tomas's accepts an earlier turn; Ravi's asks him first. Four of six vote yes, and Priya taps once.
PayPal Vault, Orders, Payouts, Invoicing, Webhooks and Balances, with the tools behind an MCP server. A free model can drive it; this take ran in rules mode.
